title: mlumr: Multilevel Unanchored Meta-Regression for Indirect Treatment Comparisons
description: Bayesian multilevel unanchored meta-regression (ML-UMR) for indirect treatment comparisons using individual patient data (IPD) and aggregate data (AgD). Implements the shared prognostic factor assumption (SPFA) and relaxed SPFA models for binary, continuous, count, and time-to-event (survival) outcomes via Stan, including parametric and flexible M-spline survival baselines, with transport of marginal treatment effects to arbitrary target populations by Bayesian g-computation (covariate-conditional effects are reported at specified profiles, not population-standardized). Also provides simulated treatment comparison (STC) via parametric G-computation and naive unadjusted benchmarks. ML-UMR is an adaptation of the multilevel network meta-regression (ML-NMR) methodology of Phillippo et al. (2020), implemented in the multinma package, to the unanchored disconnected-evidence setting.
